data.name: Fuad
data.gender_notes: Fuad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fu'dah', meaning 'opened' or 'expanded'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the heart's capacity to love and receive God's mercy. The name Fuad carries the meaning “Heart, love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fuad usually hope their child will grow to embody heart, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing new life and vitality to others.
data.etymology: Fuad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heart, love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fuad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فُؤاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: فُؤاد هو كلمة عربية معناها القلب، العاطفة، الحب، والتفاؤل. يعتبر فُؤاد جزءًا مهمًا من البنية النفسية البشرية، حيث يرتبط بشكل وثيق بالقلب والمفاصل العصبية. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم فُؤاد للإشارة إلى العاطفة والتواصل الإنساني. في الإسلام، يُعتبر فُؤاد موضع تقديس، حيث يُعتبر العاطفة الإنسانية واقعة من الله عز وجل. في القرآن الكريم، يُذكر فُؤاد في العديد من الآيات، مثل آية «فأَيَعجَبُونَ أَن جاءَ مِن عِندِ اللَّهِ رَشَدًا قَلْبُهُ» (سورة الأعراف: 179). يُستخدم فُؤاد أيضًا في الأسماء الشخصية، حيث يعتبر اسمًا مشهورًا في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية.

in_hindi.name: फ़ुआद
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ुआद एक हिंदी नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी शब्द फ़ुआद से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है दिल, प्रेम, भावना, चिंतन, और प्यार। यह नाम प्रेम, भावना, और चिंतन को दर्शाता है। इस नाम का महत्व हिंदू और इस्लामी दोनों परंपराओं में है।

in_english.name: Fuad
in_english.long_meaning: Fuad is an Arabic name that means heart, love, emotions, tenderness, compassion, and affection. It is considered a sacred name in Islam and is associated with the heart and emotions. In the Quran, the heart is mentioned as the seat of the soul and the source of emotions and feelings. Fuad is also used as a given name in many cultures and is considered a symbol of love, compassion, and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fuad holds a rich cultural heritage as it is mentioned in the Quran, where Prophet Yunus (Jonah) is given back his people after they have repented. In Arabic, it is the name of the main organ in the human body responsible for emotions and memory, adding to its intrigue and relevance to the Middle Eastern culture.
data.spiritual_significance: This mystical name connects deeply to the heart in the Islamic faith. In Sufi (Islamic mysticism) tradition, it refers to the pride of the heart, a noble organ connected to the spiritual world. It signifies the plenitude of love and mercy from Allah, representing the expansion of love and embrace towards the divine presence in human beings. It is also believed that "Fuad" is a gateway to the presence of divine love and wisdom.
